demo.banner: Demo data – all bikes and reports are made up

common.comingSoon: This page is still in progress.

check.title: Check a bike
check.body: Before buying a used bike: enter the frame number or FEIN code and see whether it has been reported stolen.
check.frameHint: Usually stamped under the bottom bracket. Spaces and dashes don't matter.
check.captchaUnavailable: Security check could not be loaded. Please try again later.

stolen.title: Reported stolen
stolen.body: Don't buy this bike. Don't confront the seller – call the police (110).

possible_match.title: Similar stolen bike found
possible_match.body: The number is similar to a stolen bike's (e.g. O instead of 0). Compare number and photos carefully with the bike in front of you.
possible_match.similarBody: A very similar frame number belongs to a bike with a prepared handover. Compare the number on the bike character by character (0/O, 1/I, 8/B) and check again.

verified_transfer.title: Safe handover prepared
verified_transfer.body: The owner has prepared a LeezenPass handover for this bike. Ask for the handover code when you pay – you'll be registered as the owner right away.

unknown.title: No entry found
unknown.body: No theft is reported for this number at LeezenPass. That doesn't mean the bike is safe – watch for the warning signs.

signs.title: Warning signs when buying used
signs.frame: Frame number scratched off, painted over or missing
signs.place: Meeting only at the station or a car park, not at home
signs.lock: No key, or a broken lock
signs.details: Seller doesn't know details of the bike
signs.tip: Make a sales contract with the frame number and ID details – or buy with a LeezenPass handover.

stolen.title: Stolen bikes
stolen.callPolice: Seen one? Call 110 and don't confront anyone.
stolen.empty: No stolen bikes for these filters.
stolen.notStolenBody: This bike is not (or no longer) on the list of stolen bikes.

login.title: Log in
login.passwordHint: At least 8 characters with upper and lower case letters and a digit.

errors.DuplicateUserName: There is already an account for this email.
errors.DuplicateEmail: There is already an account for this email.
errors.InvalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.PasswordTooShort: The password needs at least 8 characters.
errors.PasswordRequiresDigit: The password needs at least one digit.
errors.PasswordRequiresUpper: The password needs an upper case letter.
errors.PasswordRequiresLower: The password needs a lower case letter.

myBikes.title: My bikes
myBikes.emptyBody: With frame number and photos your bike can be recognised after a theft.

registerBike.title: Register bike
registerBike.body: The frame number is usually under the bottom bracket.

bikeForm.feinCodeHint: The police engraving. Stored encrypted only and never shown.
bikeForm.feinCodeStoredHint: A FEIN code is stored. Leave empty to keep it.

bikeDetail.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this bike and all its photos?
bikeDetail.registered: Bike registered. Now add photos – especially the side view and the frame number.
bikeDetail.photoUploadFailed: A photo could not be saved – please add it again below.
bikeDetail.notFound: This bike does not exist or no longer belongs to your account.

photos.title: Photos
photos.privacyHint: Location data (GPS) is removed automatically on upload.
photos.receiptPrivate: Only visible to you, never public.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.frameNumberInvalid: The frame number needs 4–32 letters or digits.
errors.frameNumberTaken: This frame number is already taken. If it's your bike, ask the previous owner to transfer it.
errors.feinCodeInvalid: The FEIN code needs 6–32 letters or digits.
errors.dateInFuture: The date is in the future.
errors.fileTooLarge: The photo is too large (max. 15 MB).
errors.unsupportedImage: Please choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a bit and try again.
errors.locationRequired: Please set a point on the map.
errors.dateTooOld: The date is too far in the past.
errors.alreadyStolen: This bike is already reported stolen.
errors.notStolen: This bike is not reported stolen.
errors.aiUnavailable: Automatic recognition not available right now.
errors.transferCodeInvalid: The code is invalid, expired or already used.
errors.transferOwnBike: This is your own code – give it to the person buying the bike.
errors.transferStolen: A bike reported stolen can't be handed over.
errors.concurrentChange: This was just changed at the same time. Please reload the page.
errors.checkInput: Please enter a frame number or FEIN code.
errors.captchaFailed: Security check failed. Please try again.
errors.challengeInvalid: The code is wrong or has expired. Show a new one.
errors.frameNumberLocked: The frame number has been checked with a receipt and can no longer be changed.

reportTheft.title: Report theft
reportTheft.intro: Your bike then appears in the public list of stolen bikes – district only, without your data and without the exact location.
reportTheft.locationHint: Tap the map or use your location. Only the district is shown publicly.
reportTheft.locationNoteHint: E.g. “bike rack at the main station”. Only for you and the police summary, never public.
reportTheft.policeCaseNoHint: You can also add it later.

map.locationFailed: Location not available. Tap the map instead.

stolenPanel.title: Reported stolen
stolenPanel.publicHint: It is on the public list (district only, no personal data).
stolenPanel.policeBody: Copy the summary and paste it into the Polizei NRW Internetwache (online police station).
stolenPanel.caseNoHint: With a case number your report is marked as “police reported”.
stolenPanel.insuranceBody: Report the theft to your household or bike insurance right away. They usually need the case number, the receipt and the bike pass.
stolenPanel.shareBody: Share the report in messengers and social media. The more people know the bike, the sooner it turns up.
stolenPanel.recoveredConfirm: Mark the bike as recovered? It will be removed from the public list.

share.stolenText: This bike was stolen in Münster ({{district}}). Seen it? Please call 110.

tag.registeredBody: No theft has been reported for this bike. Buying a used bike? Check the frame number first.
tag.unknownBody: This QR code does not belong to any registered bike. Be careful when buying: check the frame number.
tag.transferOpen: Sale prepared: safe handover with a LeezenPass code is possible.
tag.frameHint: Frame number ends in {{hint}} – compare it with the bike.

aiPrefill.title: Faster with photos (optional)
aiPrefill.body: The AI suggests type, colours, brand and frame number. You check everything before it is saved. Photos are only uploaded when you save.

hint.side: Whole bike from the side – for type, colours, brand.
hint.frame_no: Close-up of the stamped number, usually under the bottom bracket.

aiPrefill.failed: Automatic recognition not available right now – please fill in yourself.
aiPrefill.frameNotFound: No number readable – get closer or type it in.
aiPrefill.notApplied: Unsure – please check type and colours yourself
aiPrefill.review: Suggestions from the photos have been filled in. Please check them before saving.
aiPrefill.reviewFrame: Compare the frame number character by character with the frame.

transfer.title: Sell / hand over
transfer.intro: When you sell, create a one-time code. The buyer enters it in LeezenPass and is registered as the new owner right away – with a certificate.
transfer.replaceConfirm: Create a new code? The previous code stops working.
transfer.openHidden: Handover prepared (valid until {{date}}). For security the code is only shown once – create a new one if needed.
transfer.warning: Only hand over the code once you've been paid. Whoever enters the code becomes the owner.

claim.link: Take over a bought bike with a code
claim.title: Take over bike
claim.body: Enter the handover code you got from the seller.
claim.codeHint: 8 characters, e.g. ABCD-EFGH. Upper/lower case doesn't matter.
claim.success: Bike taken over – you are now registered as the owner. Your ownership certificate is below.

verify.title: Verify ownership certificate
verify.transferredAgain: The bike has since been transferred to someone else.
verify.stolenNow: This bike is currently reported stolen. Seen it? Call 110.
verify.notFoundBody: This ownership certificate does not exist at LeezenPass. It may be forged.

hint.self_declared: The details come from the owner.
hint.evidence_checked: Receipt and the bike with its frame number were checked.
hint.third_party_verified: Registered by a bike shop or ADFC coding event, or taken over from a checked previous owner.

ownership.title: Prove ownership
ownership.intro: A receipt and a photo of your bike turn “Self-declared” into “Checked with receipt”. Buyers see this in the check and in your listing link.
ownership.receiptHint: Invoice or sales contract with the frame number, or brand, model and date. The receipt stays private and is deleted on a handover.
ownership.possessionTitle: Photograph the bike with a code
ownership.possessionHint: Write the code on a piece of paper, put it next to the frame number and take one photo of both. This photo is not stored.
ownership.codeExpired: The code has expired. Show a new one.
ownership.retry: The photo isn't clear enough. Please take a new one, with good light and no glare.
ownership.receiptFailed: This receipt doesn't match this bike: neither the frame number nor brand, model and purchase date match.
ownership.possessionFailed: That doesn't match: the code or the frame number is different. Check both and try again.
ownership.aiUnavailable: The check isn't possible right now. Please try again in a moment.
